Exceptionally good food!
Jul 2016 • Solo
Staying in the Old Quarter for some time I have diner in different places to spread my money around and to try which is worthwhile to come back to.
Today I went to King Cafe which is only a couple of steps from my hotel.
First of all, this is more of a restaurant than a cafe. Let me tell you why...the price of a bottle of beer is Đ 20.000 which is slightly higher than in the street. And the menu (which I find to be more important) is very extensive. You won't find a menu like this on the street.
I ordered the crab springrolls and the noodles with fried pork and vegetables. What a pleasant surprise...the two dishes are one of the best I had in almost 5 months in Vietnam!! Exceptional!
As the food tasted so good I actually wanted to order some more. But because I was pretty stuffed and I hate wasting food I decided I'd come back tomorrow. The utmost friendly owner brought me a banana as desert, but I still wanted more. So I ordered a banana pancake with honey. Delicious!

I cannot recommend King Cafe enough to have excellent food in the Old Quarter in Hanoi.
I will be here for sure tomorrow (14 July 2016) and some other days to try different dishes. Watch out for the tall bold guy with a beard. 😄
